sentences.text:
This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.V.A.SATHEESH, M.VIVEK RABINDRANATH,
Advocates for the petitioner and of the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent,the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.
 C.S.SUDHA, J.
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 Crl.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024 in Crl. Appeal No.2216 of 2024  &
 Crl.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024 in Crl. Appeal No.2226 of 2024  ---------------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 10th day of January 2025  ORDER These are applications filed under Section 430(1) of the Bharathiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
seeking suspension of sentence of the applicants/accused in S.C. No.61 of 2016 on the file of the Siraj.Ch vs State Of Kerala on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11035583/
1 Court of Session, Thalassery.

The applicants/accused persons have been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 489 B and 489 C IPC and have been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of five years and to a fine of 25,000/- each.
2. The applications are opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

The learned Public Prosecutor on instructions submits that the applicant/first accused in Crl.A.No.2226/2024 has two crimes registered against him, one under Section 420 IPC and the other under Section 279 IPC.
3. Heard both sides.
Crl. Appeal Nos. 2216 & 2226 of 2024 4.
It is also made clear that if any of the conditions are violated, the bail shall stand cancelled.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The applicants/accused persons have been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 489 B and 489 C IPC and have been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of five years and to a fine of 25,000/- each.
The learned Public Prosecutor on instructions submits that the applicant/first accused in Crl.A.No.2226/2024 has two crimes registered against him, one under Section 420 IPC and the other under Section 279 IPC.
3. Heard both sides.
Crl. Appeal Nos. 2216 & 2226 of 2024 4.
In the interest of justice, the substantive sentence of imprisonment imposed on the applicants/accused persons is suspended till the disposal of the appeal subject to the following conditions:-
i) The applicants/accused persons shall be released on bail on executing a bond for 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial court;
ii) They shall deposit the entire fine amount within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
iii) They shall not commit any offence(s) while on bail;
iv) If the conviction and sentence of the applicants/accused persons is upheld or even modified, the time during which they are so released shall be excluded in computing the term of their sentence as provided in Section 430(4) BNSS.
It is also made clear that if any of the conditions are violated, the bail shall stand cancelled.
